end.summary: Defined food miles as the distance food travels from where it is grown to where it is eaten.
end.parentNote: Rohan practised identifying food miles, comparing local and distant foods, and linking shorter distances with less fuel. They used seasonal mangoes to explain that local food can be fresh and less costly, and recognised that choosing only nearby food may not work in every season. Earlier, they mixed up imported food being better or more special; this was corrected later by discussing local, seasonal, fresh options. At home, compare two foods and discuss where they came from, their season, and the travel distance.
